name: Teneligliptin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 20 mg once daily; may increase to 40 mg once daily with close monitoring if response is inadequate

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Class IA (quinidine, procainamide) and class III (amiodarone, sotalol) antiarrhythmics
key_interactions.action: Use with caution; avoid in QT prolongation.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Beta-blockers, salicylates, MAO inhibitors; corticosteroids, thyroid hormone, epinephrine

contraindications: Severe ketosis, diabetic coma or precoma, type 1 diabetes
Severe infection, around surgery, serious trauma
monitoring: ECG in patients with QT risk

pk.half_life: About 24 hours (single dose); about 30 hours after 7 days
pk.half_life_eskd: AUC up to about 1.68-fold (moderate impairment); 1.16-fold in end-stage kidney failure

sources.citation: Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma (Thailand). (2021). Tenelia 20 mg tablets (teneligliptin hydrobromide hydrate) [Summary of product characteristics, authorization 1C 15074/63 (NC); text revised September 2021]. Thai Food and Drug Administration.
